meta.title: DSH AgentDeck
meta.description: Ready-to-use native agents with role customization, actual model settings and task results.

ui.transferExportHint: Select roles to export. The file contains saved models, reasoning settings and complete candidate pools. Each machine supplies its own connections.
ui.transferImportHint: Review roles and map routes to local models. Uncheck a role to skip it. Instructions, skills and other settings are preserved.
ui.transferInheritedHint: Inherited settings use the destination Session model and reasoning. Model availability and Session authorization are determined locally.
ui.transferChecking: Checking local models or preparing change previews…
ui.transferRemoveDefaultHint: To skip the default candidate, first choose another default above.
ui.transferSaveHint: After reviewing the preview, stage the drafts and save each role. Saving checks current revisions and inheritance impacts again.
ui.transferStaged: Model settings are staged in role drafts. Review and save each role to apply them.
ui.transferGlobalOnly: Select global settings to import model settings.
ui.transferTargetMissing: This role is missing locally. Choose a destination or uncheck it to skip.
ui.transferDuplicateTarget: Multiple entries target the same role. Keep one or choose another destination.
ui.transferSourceOwned: This role is managed by a local project or external file. Choose another role or skip it.
ui.transferChanged: Local settings or drafts changed. Preview again; for a revision conflict, import the file again.
ui.transferDraftConflict: This role has an unsaved draft. Save or discard it first, or uncheck the role to skip.
ui.transferProviderMissing: This provider is missing locally. Choose a local provider and model, or skip the role.
ui.transferUnresolved: This model has not been verified locally. Choose another model or recheck.
ui.transferTextRequired: This model does not support text input. Choose a model suitable for agent tasks.
ui.transferEffortMissing: The local model does not support this reasoning effort. Choose another effort or use the model default.
ui.modelTransferInvalid: Invalid settings bundle or unsupported version. Use a JSON file created by Export model settings.
ui.title: AgentDeck
ui.intro: Ready-to-use agents, with your own settings.
ui.requestTimeout: The read request took more than 15 seconds. Retry when the Host is ready. Your drafts are preserved.
ui.noCatalog: Agent definitions could not be loaded.
ui.chooseRole: Choose an agent to see its settings.
ui.modelDeniedHint: The selected model {route} is not authorized for this Session.
ui.authorizationRecovery: Choose an allowed model here and save, or configure native /model-selection-settings and create a new Session. Changes to native authorization settings do not update an existing Session.
ui.capabilityPending: Live readiness still needs to be checked for {items}. Select a role to check its available browser backend. The child checks its actual tools again before use.
ui.sessionHint: Select a Session to see its actual model authorization. This does not grant access.
ui.changeWrite: Save to the shared user override.
ui.setupStale: This proposal was generated for {context}. Generate again to apply changes.
ui.invalidContext: Use whole token counts between 1 and 16,777,216, with elastic tokens at least the target.
ui.useProjectEdit: Edit using this Session’s project context
ui.projectReadOnly: This Session shows project settings in read-only mode.
ui.projectWriteBound: Editing in the project context of Session {session}. Changes use the shared override store.
ui.draftScopeMismatch: This draft belongs to {session}. Return to that context to edit or save it.
ui.autoExitMigration: Resources to keep when leaving automatic mode
ui.openValidatedForm: Validate YAML and edit in form
ui.setupSessionHint: Used for setup authorization and model validation. It does not change the detail view.
ui.runParentHint: Filter saved runs by their recorded parent Session.
ui.newHint: Start from an existing agent. The Host validates the complete definition when you save.
ui.idHint: Use a unique lowercase id, for example project-reviewer.
ui.importHint: Review the imported YAML and confirm its agent id before saving.
ui.yamlHint: Edit the complete override. JSON syntax is also valid YAML. Saving applies to new tasks.
ui.yamlLocked: Save or discard this YAML draft before using the structured controls.
ui.saved: Saved. New tasks use this revision.
ui.discardConfirm: Discard the unsaved changes for this agent?
ui.saveError: Could not save. Your draft is preserved.
ui.resetConfirm: Reset this customization? New tasks will use the factory definition.
ui.deleteConfirm: Delete this custom agent? Its running tasks keep their pinned revision.
ui.newStarts: Changes apply to new tasks. Running tasks keep their original revision.
ui.budgetHint: Preview uses the saved agent and actual model metadata.
ui.unknownBudget: The model context window is unknown. Safe capacity cannot be calculated.
ui.previewDraft: Save this draft to preview its effective budget.
ui.noRuns: No AgentDeck tasks in this scope.
ui.runsHint: Latest 200 runs matching the parent Session filter. Opening a result verifies the outcome as of that check.
ui.provisionalText: Provisional output from this turn. No final result text is available.
ui.resultEmpty: No result text is available yet.
ui.captureWorkspaceCuts: Record workspaces for the DSH upgrade
ui.captureWorkspaceHelp: Stop parent Sessions and pause new work before recording. Keep this profile and its workspace paths available for rollback.
ui.importTooLarge: Import is limited to 1 MiB. Your existing drafts are preserved.
ui.invalidId: Enter an agent id before saving.
ui.missingRevision: Refresh this agent before replacing an existing customization.
ui.AGENTDECK_IMPACT_PREVIEW_REQUIRED: Preview the exact changes before saving.
ui.AGENTDECK_IMPACT_PREVIEW_CHANGED: The impact preview has changed. Review it again.
ui.AGENTDECK_IMPACT_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Confirm each affected role in the current preview.
ui.AGENTDECK_RESULT_CHANGED: The result has changed. Reload the first page to continue.
ui.malformedResponse: The Host returned an invalid operation response.
ui.duplicateId: This id already exists. Select that agent to edit it, or choose a new id.
ui.unsavedImport: Imported YAML is staged locally. Review and save to apply it.
ui.effectiveHint: Configured values describe the saved agent. Validated values reflect the selected Session.
ui.autoHint: Auto mode supports multiple candidates. Give each candidate a different task purpose; the default is used when a task does not select another candidate.
ui.candidateHint: Choose a configured provider and model. Use “Add another candidate” to keep adding candidates; preview reads only the selected saved candidate.
ui.noModelOptions: This provider has no configured models. Choose another provider or configure a model in DSH.
ui.outputCapHint: Leave blank to use the parent or native default. A cap applies to new tasks.
ui.outputPending: Output parameters have not been validated for this Session.
ui.assemblyPending: Actual fit is pending real child Session assembly.
ui.invalidForm: Complete the configuration below before saving.
ui.invalidRoute: Enter both provider and model ids.
ui.invalidOutput: Use a whole output cap from 1 to 16777216 tokens, or leave it blank.
ui.invalidCandidates: Add at least one candidate with a unique lowercase ID and select an existing default.
ui.invalidCandidate: Candidate {number}: enter a lowercase ID (up to 64 characters), purpose (1–240 characters), provider and model. Enter an effort when using fixed reasoning.
ui.existingNewDraft: Your previous new-agent draft is preserved. Continue editing it or discard it before starting another.
ui.draftConflict: This agent already has unsaved changes. Save or discard that draft before importing.
ui.setupHint: Choose your configured models and agents, review the suggested changes, then apply the selected rows.
ui.setupLimit: This configures AgentDeck agents. Plugin installation, plugin settings and native model permissions are managed in DSH.
ui.setupInheritance: Derived agents keep their inheritance. Updating a base can also affect descendants that inherit its settings.
ui.setupApplyHint: Applies to new tasks. Each row is checked before saving; the batch stops at the first failure and keeps successful rows.
ui.setupReconciled: Readback after an unconfirmed response; nothing was replayed
ui.browserReadyHint: Browser support was verified. Refresh to check again.
ui.browserUnverifiedHint: Browser support has not been verified in this view.
ui.browserUnsupportedHint: Browser support is unavailable in this environment.
ui.setup.status.observed: Suggested text observed; write attribution unconfirmed
ui.setup.imageRoute: Use the selected image model for browser verification.
ui.setup.sourceOwned: Edit this agent in its source: {source}
ui.setup.metadataMissing: Resolve the selected model metadata before applying.
ui.setup.metadataFailed: Could not read metadata for {provider}/{model}. Expand the original diagnostic for the cause, then retry generating suggestions.
ui.setup.outputAssumed: Input estimates use the model default output. A Session may inherit a different output limit.
ui.setup.sessionNoCapacity: The current Session output limit leaves no input capacity. Existing input targets are preserved; saving does not change that Session.
ui.setup.imageRequired: Browser verification requires a model with declared image input.
ui.setup.textRequired: Agent roles require a model that supports text input.
ui.setup.authorizationWarning: The current Session does not authorize this model. Saving does not grant authorization.
ui.setup.capabilityWarning: Some runtime capabilities are missing or unverified. Saving does not enable plugins.
ui.setup.noCapacity: The output reservation exhausts this model context window.
ui.setup.contextClamped: Adjust input targets to the safe capacity declared by this model: {tokens} tokens.
ui.setup.capacityUnknown: Context or output capacity is unknown. Existing targets are preserved.
ui.setupScopeSummary: Selected: {selected} roles · Protected: {protected} roles. Existing matching inheritance needs no configuration step.
ui.setupReviewSummary: Direct changes: {changed} · Unchanged: {unchanged} · Preserved: {preserved} · Needs attention: {blocked} · Indirect: {indirect}
ui.setupStrategyHint: Choose a strategy, review only the changed roles, then save. Settings are global role overrides, not copies for this Session.
ui.setupInheritHint: The default path asks AI to analyze the selected roles and constraints, then returns a plan for review.
ui.setupAutoHint: Ask AI to analyze the selected roles, available models and constraints, then review the generated candidates before saving.
ui.setupAiProposalHint: No candidate pool is required. AI uses the selected provider and model once and returns a read-only proposal; you still choose rows and approve impacts before saving.
ui.setupAiGeneratorHint: Choose a configured provider. Pick a suggested model or enter its ID. AgentDeck checks this route when you generate the proposal.
ui.setupGeneratorModelPlaceholder: Choose or enter a model ID
ui.setupOutput.clear: Clear the role limit and inherit
ui.setupCandidateCapHint: Required for every candidate. Only a declared model default can prefill this value; review it before saving.
ui.setupBrowserSeparate: Use a separate fixed image model for browser roles
ui.setupReplace: Allow replacement of existing overrides (select roles manually)
ui.setupProtectHint: Existing overrides, disabled roles, source-owned roles and unsaved drafts are protected by default. Unlocking replacement never selects additional roles.
ui.setupMigrationHint: Choose which candidate supplies reasoning and output, or explicitly reset them. No values are copied silently.
ui.setupInputsIncomplete: Complete the selected fixed strategy before generating.
ui.setupNoChanges: No configuration changes to save. Existing or protected settings were retained.
ui.setupNoApplicable: No changes can be saved yet. Review the diagnostics below.
ui.setupIndirectHint: Saving a base can change derived roles, including protected or excluded roles. Partial saves can leave an intermediate state even when the final resources would match. Confirm each affected role.
ui.setupPrefixImpacts: Intermediate resources after each saved prefix
ui.setupAcceptImpact: I accept the final and intermediate resource changes for this role
ui.setup.configuredPreserved: Existing or disabled settings were preserved.
ui.setup.migrationRequired: Choose a candidate resource migration or explicitly reset before leaving candidate mode.
ui.setup.migrationCandidateMissing: The migration candidate no longer exists. Select it again.
ui.setup.defaultCandidateFiltered: The default candidate is not a declared image model. Choose a valid default explicitly.
ui.setup.candidatesFiltered: Non-image candidates were excluded from the browser pool.
ui.setup.effortUnsupported: A selected model does not declare this reasoning effort.
ui.setup.inheritanceUnverified: Inherited model resources or image support are not verified without matching Session metadata.
ui.setup.authorizationUnknown: Session authorization is unverified. Saving does not grant authorization.
ui.setup.strategyGenerated: Use the AI-generated strategy after local validation.
ui.setup.generatedStrategyInvalid: The AI-generated strategy is invalid or missing. Regenerate to configure this role.
ui.setup.strategySelected: Apply the selected strategy without model rankings or speculative discovery.
ui.suggestOpenTitle: Let AI help configure the model
ui.suggestOpenFixedHint: Suggest a fixed model and reasoning settings; the result goes into the draft first.
ui.suggestOpenAutoHint: Generate one or more candidates. Choose the generator, then choose how many candidates to request.
ui.suggestFixedHint: Suggest one fixed model and its reasoning settings. A complete fixed route you selected is kept.
ui.suggestAutoHint: AI can generate multiple candidates at once; each candidate should have a distinct task purpose.
ui.suggestGeneratorHint: Choose the model that will generate this suggestion. This choice does not set the agent’s execution model.
ui.suggestPlanAuto: Let AI decide from the task
ui.suggestPlanHint: By default, AI decides whether more than one candidate is useful.
ui.suggestMultipleHint: AI will generate at least 2 candidates for different task purposes; you can edit or add more afterward.
ui.suggestGenerateHint: Choose a generator model, then click “Generate configuration suggestion”. The result only changes this draft until you save it.
ui.suggestStale: The draft or request has changed. Generate again before adopting.
ui.suggestAdoptHint: Adoption changes this agent’s draft. Review or edit it, then save normally.
ui.suggestAdopted: Adopted into this draft. Save when ready.
ui.nativeRecoveryHint: Uses the model’s native window and recovery. No separate AgentDeck input budget or output limit.
ui.previewSessionHint: No live Session is selected. Model declarations and native window information remain visible; select a live Session to validate authorization and effective parameters. AI suggestions themselves do not require a Session.
